payment_orphan.subject: Alert: orphan payment recorded — transaction :id
payment_orphan.intro: An **orphan payment** has been recorded on the platform. The payment was charged in Stripe but the linked resource was not found in the database when processing the webhook (it may have been deleted between the checkout start and payment confirmation).
payment_orphan.instruction: Action required: review the payment in the admin panel and determine whether a manual refund should be issued or the payment should be linked to another resource.

evaluate.renewal_banner_title: 🔄 This is a RENEWAL of the editorial seal
evaluate.renewal_banner_policy: If this evaluation scores ≥75% with all critical indicators met, the seal will be extended automatically. Otherwise there is no refund: the editor paid for the evaluation, not for the seal.
renewal_evaluation.subject: New paid renewal pending evaluation
renewal_evaluation.intro: An editor paid for an Editorial Standards Seal renewal. The journal has re-entered the evaluation flow and requires a new editorial review.
renewal_evaluation.instruction: Start the re-evaluation when possible. If the final score is ≥75% and all critical indicators are met, the seal will be renewed automatically.
renewal_approved.subject: Your editorial seal has been successfully renewed
renewal_approved.intro: Your journal **":title"** passed the renewal re-evaluation. The Editorial Standards Seal has been extended.
renewal_approved.thanks: Thank you for upholding your editorial quality commitment.
renewal_rejected.subject: Your seal could not be renewed
renewal_rejected.intro: Your seal for **":title"** was not renewed because the evaluation did not reach the required 75%.
renewal_rejected.completed: The evaluation you paid for has been completed. Here are the details:
renewal_rejected.retry_offer: To retry, you can purchase a **re-evaluation** at a lower cost and work on the failed indicators before submitting again.
renewal_rejected.support: If you have questions about the failed indicators, please contact our team.

notifications.seal_early_reminder.subjec: Your editorial seal expires in :days days — Editorial Standards Platform
notifications.seal_early_reminder.line1: We are writing to let you know that the Editorial Standards Seal for your journal **":title"** expires in **:days days** (on :date). There is still plenty of time to renew without any rush.
notifications.seal_early_reminder.line2: Renewing before the expiration date ensures your seal never lapses and your journal keeps its certified visibility in the directory.
notifications.seal_early_reminder.line3: An early renewal benefit is coming soon. For now, you can start the process from your dashboard.
notifications.seal_early_reminder.footer: Thank you for trusting Editorial Standards Platform.

notifications.seal_expiring_soon.line2: Renew now to keep your certification active without interruption.

notifications.seal_expired.subject: The seal for ":title" has expired
notifications.seal_expired.line1: The Editorial Standards Seal for your journal **":title"** has expired.
notifications.seal_expired.line2: This means the seal is no longer valid and should not be displayed on your website. Your journal retains its score and evaluation.
notifications.seal_expired.line3: You can renew the seal at any time. The renewal includes a new evaluation that validates your current editorial standards.
notifications.seal_expired.line4: Start the renewal now to recover your certification.
notifications.seal_expired.footer: Thank you for trusting Editorial Standards Platform.
notifications.seal_recovery.subject: You can still recover the seal for ":title"
notifications.seal_recovery.line1: It has been a few days since the seal for **":title"** expired, but you can still recover it.
notifications.seal_recovery.line2: You can still recover your seal. The renewal includes a new evaluation that validates your current editorial standards. If you score ≥75% with all critical indicators met, the seal is renewed automatically.
notifications.seal_recovery.line3: Do not wait — the sooner you start the renewal, the sooner you can display the certification on your website again.
notifications.seal_recovery.footer: Thank you for trusting Editorial Standards Platform.
